## 1. Core Concepts & Architecture

`persian-date-native` is built directly on top of JavaScript's native `Date` object without intermediate wrapper overhead.
- Inherits all standard Date methods (`getTime()`, `toISOString()`, `getTimezoneOffset()`, `toJSON()`).
- Immutable date arithmetic methods: `add()`, `subtract()`, `startOf()`, `endOf()`.
- Zero external runtime dependencies.
- Sub-microsecond pure integer conversions.

---

## 2. Installation & CDN

```bash
npm install persian-date-native
# or
pnpm add persian-date-native
# or
yarn add persian-date-native
# or
bun add persian-date-native
```

Browser CDN:
```html
<script src="https://unpkg.com/persian-date-native"></script>
<!-- Available globally as window.PersianDateNative -->
```

ESM CDN:
```javascript
import { persianDate } from "https://esm.sh/persian-date-native";
```

---

## 3. Function Signatures & Types

### Factory Function
```typescript
function persianDate(
  ...args: [Date | string | number | undefined, Options?] |
           [number, number, number, number?, number?, number?, number?, Options?]
): PersianDate;
```

### Pure Integer Converters
```typescript
function gregorianToPersian(gy: number, gm: number, gd: number): [jy: number, jm: number, jd: number];
function persianToGregorian(jy: number, jm: number, jd: number): [gy: number, gm: number, gd: number];
```

### Date Conversion Helpers
```typescript
function toPersianDate(date?: Date | string | number): { year: number; month: number; day: number };
function toGregorianDate(jy: number, jm: number, jd: number): Date;
```

### Digits & Relative Time
```typescript
function toPersianDigits(input: string | number): string;
function replacePersianNumbers(input: string): string;
function isPersianLeapYear(year: number): boolean;
function relativeTime(fromTime: number, toTime: number, options?: { withoutSuffix?: boolean; digits?: "en" | "fa" }): string;
```

---

## 4. PersianDate Class API

```typescript
class PersianDate extends Date {
  format(template?: string, options?: { digits?: "en" | "fa" }): string;
  formatFa(template?: string): string;
  toArray(): [year: number, month: number, day: number, hour: number, min: number, sec: number, ms: number];
  clone(): PersianDate;
  
  getDayOfWeek(): number; // 0=Sat, 1=Sun, ..., 6=Fri
  isWeekend(): boolean;   // true if Friday
  quarter(): number;      // 1..4
  isLeapYear(): boolean;
  daysInMonth(): number;  // 31, 30, or 29 (30 on leap years)

  fromNow(withoutSuffix?: boolean, options?: { digits?: "en" | "fa" }): string;
  toNow(withoutSuffix?: boolean, options?: { digits?: "en" | "fa" }): string;
  from(target: Date | PersianDate | string | number, withoutSuffix?: boolean, options?: { digits?: "en" | "fa" }): string;
  to(target: Date | PersianDate | string | number, withoutSuffix?: boolean, options?: { digits?: "en" | "fa" }): string;

  add(value: number, unit: "year" | "month" | "week" | "day" | "hour" | "minute" | "second"): this;
  subtract(value: number, unit: "year" | "month" | "week" | "day" | "hour" | "minute" | "second"): this;
  startOf(unit: "year" | "month" | "week" | "day" | "hour" | "minute" | "second"): this;
  endOf(unit: "year" | "month" | "week" | "day" | "hour" | "minute" | "second"): this;

  isBefore(target: Date | PersianDate | string | number): boolean;
  isAfter(target: Date | PersianDate | string | number): boolean;
  isSame(target: Date | PersianDate | string | number, unit?: "year" | "month" | "day"): boolean;
  diff(target: Date | PersianDate | string | number, unit?: "years" | "months" | "weeks" | "days" | "hours" | "minutes" | "seconds"): number;
}
```

---

## 5. Day.js Plugin

```typescript
import dayjs from "dayjs";
import { jalaliPlugin } from "persian-date-native";

dayjs.extend(jalaliPlugin);

const d = dayjs().calendar("jalali");
console.log(d.format("YYYY/MM/DD"));
```

---

## 6. Framework Integrations

### React
```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { persianDate } from "persian-date-native";

export function Clock() {
  const [d, setD] = useState(() => persianDate());
  return <div>{d.formatFa("dddd D MMMM YYYY")}</div>;
}
```

### Next.js (App Router)
```tsx
import { persianDate } from "persian-date-native";

export default function Page() {
  const serverDate = persianDate();
  return <div>تاریخ سرور: {serverDate.formatFa("YYYY/MM/DD")}</div>;
}
```

### Vue 3
```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from "vue";
import { persianDate } from "persian-date-native";
const date = ref(persianDate());
</script>
<template><div>{{ date.formatFa("dddd D MMMM YYYY") }}</div></template>
```
